documents.text: Technician Yudi Pratama June log: closed 16 jobs across Jabodetabek and out-of-town Kalimantan (Tarakan, Nunukan). First-time-fix on 14 of 16 jobs. Two jobs still waiting on spare parts.
Yudi Pratama review note: carries most of the out-of-town installs; flagged that spare-part stockouts are his single biggest delay; strong ownership on the Kalimantan trips.
Technician Dedi Kurniawan June log: closed 10 jobs, mostly Jabodetabek service and scheduled maintenance; first-time-fix on 9 of 10; one job outstanding on a water-hose stockout.
Roster balance: out-of-town jobs concentrate on Yudi Pratama. If he is unavailable, Kalimantan coverage is a risk — spread the out-of-town roster across technicians.
Technician Febri Santoso June log: closed 8 jobs, mostly Jabodetabek service and scheduled maintenance.

Technician Arman Hakim June log: closed 3 jobs, mostly Jabodetabek service and scheduled maintenance.
